caption: The drawing depicts two views of the same formal dress, both seen from the back. The primary object is a detailed illustration of a long, cream-colored gown with a bustle skirt, train, and fitted bodice. The gown features a large bow at the back waist, draped and gathered fabric forming the bustle, and various decorative elements including lace trim at the neckline, cuffs, and lower hem, along with small blue and purple floral accents on the left sleeve and along the train. The fabric appears glossy, indicated by light shading. The secondary object, on the right side, is a less detailed line drawing of the same dress, showing the structure without color or shading and highlighting the bodice seams, fringe, and train. The background is a plain, light beige color.
title: Wedding Dress
